title: The underground apartment complex
content: Idk if anyone else has experienced this place, but this was nightmarish. I took an elevator far underground to this town which had a liminal apartment-like layout with the center of the town in the middle and all the houses lining the walls and stacked on top of each other like an apartment building. They were all an off-white color and there was a park in the center with astroturf where everyone congregated. The people there seemed to be in some sort of cult. They all wore white garments like kimonos and linen clothing. Originally they didn’t really notice I was there, but then they did they formed a circle around me and started singing in these off putting harmonies. I then was paralyzed, fell back, and floated off the ground a few feet and felt really heavy vibrations. I woke up in a jolt. This is just one of my very lucid, memorable experiences in mall world. It was very similar to the picture along with this post.
